papers.title: Comparison of Two Medications Aimed at Slowing Aortic Root Enlargement in Individuals With Marfan Syndrome
papers.summary: Marfan syndrome is a hereditary connective tissue disorder. Many individuals with this condition die because of the associated heart and blood vessel abnormalities. This study will compare the effectiveness of two medications, losartan and atenolol, at slowing aortic root enlargement in individuals with Marfan syndrome.

papers.title: The Oxford Marfan Trial
papers.summary: The primary objective of the trial is to estimate the effects of allocation to irbesartan, or doxycycline, or a combination of both irbesartan and doxycycline, compared with placebo, on measures of elastic function of the aorta in people with the Marfan syndrome and enlargement of the aorta.

papers.title: Nebivolol Versus Losartan Versus Nebivolol+Losartan Against Aortic Root Dilation in Genotyped Marfan Patients
papers.summary: The major clinical problems in patients with Marfan Syndrome (MFS) are aortic root dilation (ARD), dissection and rupture. Although the available treatments (beta-blockers, BBs) improve the evolution of the disease, they do not protect MFS patients from progression of ARD and dissection. A key molecule that negatively influences cell growth, differentiation, survival and death in MFS is TGFb which is antagonised by existing drugs employed in the clinical practice, the Angiotensin II receptor blockers (ARB).

papers.title: Clinical Variability in Marfan Syndrome
papers.summary:
Marfan syndrome is an autosomal dominant connective tissue disorder caused by mutations in the fibrillin-1 gene (FBN1). Penetrance of FBN1 mutations is complete but intra and inter familial clinical expressivity is extremely variable. The underlying mechanisms for variability are not understood. An interesting mechanism is that the expression level of the wild type and/or mutated allele may play a role in the determination of variability.

papers.title: Comparison of Aliskiren vs Negative Controls on Aortic Stiffness in Patients With MFS
papers.summary:
Marfan syndrome (MFS) is an inherited disorder of connective tissue with morbidity and mortality from aortic dilatation and dissection. The current standard of care is beta-blocker (BB) treatment and therapeutic target is heart rate. The degree of aortic dilatation and response to BB vary in adults with MFS. However, aortic stiffness is often present, and can be a predictor of aortic dilatation and cardiovascular complications. Aortic stiffness is a logical therapeutic target in adults with MFS.

papers.title: Complex Aortic Aneurysm Repair Using Physician Modified Endografts and Custom Made Devices
papers.summary: The purpose of this study is to evaluate the safety and efficacy of custom made devices, Zenith t-Branch devices and physician modification of FDA approved off-the-shelf endovascular grafts in the treatment of patients with complex abdominal aneurysms, aortoiliac aneurysms, thoracoabdominal aneurysms and aortic arch aneurysms who (1) have anatomy not suitable for endovascular repair using grafts currently marketed in the United States,(2) are deemed unsafe to wait the required time necessary for commercial endograft manufacturing, and (3) are at high risk for open surgical repair. papers.title: Randomized, Double-blind Study for the Evaluation of the Effect of Losartan Versus Placebo on Aortic Root Dilatation in Patients With Marfan Syndrome Under Treatment With Beta-blockers
papers.summary: To study the effect of losartan (an angiotensin receptor blocker-ARB) on aortic root growth in patients with Marfan syndrome, already treated with beta-blockers (BB). The effect of losartan will be compared to placebo. Losartan or placebo will be added to the treatment regimen in a two-step up-titration scheme over 2 weeks. Start doses of Losartan will be 25 mg for subjects under 50kg of weight and 50mg if the weight is over 50kg. Uptitration will be guided by the tolerance of the drug by the patients. papers.title: Comparison of Medical Therapies in Marfan Syndrome.
papers.summary: The investigators are looking at the different impacts of atenolol, verapamil and perindopril on large artery and lv function in marfan syndrome. It is a double-blind, randomised cross-over trial.

papers.title: Hemodynamics Response to Upper Airway Obstruction in Marfan Syndrome
papers.summary: Upper airway obstruction (UAO) is an unrecognized source of hemodynamic stress that may contribute to aortic adverse events in persons with Marfan Syndrome (MFS). UAO occurs during snoring and sleep apnea and is characterized by repetitive partial or complete obstruction of the upper airway during sleep. These obstructive breathing events lead to intermittent surges in blood pressure (BP) REF and large decreases in pleural pressure (Pes), thereby increasing the trans-mural aortic pressure (TMP) and imposing mechanical stress on the aorta during sleep. unread.title: Successful Mitral Valve Replacement in an Infant with Neonatal Marfan Syndrome due to a Novel Missense Mutation of the FBN1 Gene.
unread.why: A neonatal Marfan case with long-term follow-up suggests that early mitral valve replacement improved critical mitral regurgitation and clinical condition.

unread.title: Comprehensive molecular screening of the FBN1 gene favors locus homogeneity of classical Marfan syndrome.
unread.why: The study establishes a multi-method FBN1 testing workflow that detects variants in at least 91% of a clinically diagnosed Marfan cohort.

unread.title: Performant Mutation Identification Using Targeted Next-Generation Sequencing of 14 Thoracic Aortic Aneurysm Genes.
unread.why: The validated gene panel, MLPA, and confirmatory sequencing provide a high-performing diagnostic workflow for FBN1 and other thoracic aortic aneurysm genes.

unread.title: The importance of mutation detection in Marfan syndrome and Marfan-related disorders: report of 193 FBN1 mutations.
unread.why: Large-scale FBN1 testing in 508 patients and 331 relatives demonstrates its utility for diagnosis, carrier screening, prenatal testing, counseling, and preventive management.

unread.title: Comprehensive genetic analysis of relevant four genes in 49 patients with Marfan syndrome or Marfan-related phenotypes.
unread.why: Direct sequencing of four connective-tissue disease genes identified FBN1 and TGFBR-pathogenic variants and delineated overlapping Marfan and Loeys-Dietz phenotypes.

unread.title: Correlation between large FBN1 deletions and severe cardiovascular phenotype in Marfan syndrome: Analysis of two novel cases and analytical review of the literature.
unread.why: The study supplies a workflow for detecting large FBN1 deletions and links deletion location, regulatory-element loss, and cardiovascular severity.

unread.title: Marfan syndrome and its disorder in periodontal tissues.
unread.why: FBN1-mutant patient-derived periodontal ligament cells were used to investigate fibrillin-1-dependent cell alignment and tissue architecture.

unread.title: Aneurysm syndromes caused by mutations in the TGF-beta receptor.
unread.why: The large Loeys-Dietz cohort links TGFBR1/TGFBR2 genotyping and phenotype severity to early prophylactic vascular surgery and long-term outcomes relevant to Marfan-associated aneurysmal disease.

unread.title: Delineation of the Marfan phenotype associated with mutations in exons 23-32 of the FBN1 gene.
unread.why: Targeted analysis of FBN1 exons 23-32 and comparison with previous variants defines a severe neonatal and cardiovascular phenotype region that can inform testing and genetic counseling.

unread.title: Clinically relevant variants in a large cohort of Indian patients with Marfan syndrome and related disorders identified by next-generation sequencing.
unread.why: Demonstrates a targeted NGS panel that achieved molecular diagnoses in 85% of a Marfan-related cohort and is directly reusable for diagnosis and research.

unread.title: Evaluating the quality of Marfan genotype-phenotype correlations in existing FBN1 databases.
unread.why: Directly develops and evaluates reusable FBN1 genotype-phenotype resources and a scoring tool for interpreting Marfan-associated variants.

unread.title: Variants in ADRB1 and CYP2C9: Association with Response to Atenolol and Losartan in Marfan Syndrome.
unread.why: Identifies an ADRB1 genotype associated with differential response to atenolol versus losartan in Marfan syndrome and proposes a clinically actionable pharmacogenetic approach.

unread.title: Marfan syndrome: whole-exome sequencing reveals de novo mutations, second gene and genotype-phenotype correlations in the Chinese population.
unread.why: This study directly applies whole-exome sequencing and genotype analysis to Marfan syndrome and reports data on de novo, double, and potentially modifying variants.

unread.title: Investigation of Strategies to Block Downstream Effectors of AT1R-Mediated Signalling to Prevent Aneurysm Formation in Marfan Syndrome.
unread.why: The paper experimentally tests multiple drugs and combination strategies in a Marfan mouse model and reports effects on aneurysm progression.

unread.title: Circulating transforming growth factor-beta in Marfan syndrome.
unread.why: The study validates circulating TGF-beta1 as a disease-associated and treatment-responsive biomarker and provides preclinical drug-effect data in Marfan mice.

unread.title: Genotype and phenotype analysis of 171 patients referred for molecular study of the fibrillin-1 gene FBN1 because of suspected Marfan syndrome.
unread.why: The study validates molecular FBN1 testing as a diagnostic aid in a large Marfan referral cohort and quantifies its yield across clinical groups.

unread.title: Genotype impacts survival in Marfan syndrome.
unread.why: Longitudinal registry data show that FBN1 mutation type stratifies aortic dissection and cardiovascular mortality risk in Marfan syndrome.

unread.title: Identification of 29 novel and nine recurrent fibrillin-1 (FBN1) mutations and genotype-phenotype correlations in 76 patients with Marfan syndrome.
unread.why: The study identifies numerous FBN1 variants and provides clinically relevant genotype–phenotype associations, including ectopia lentis risk.

unread.title: Identification of the minimal combination of clinical features in probands for efficient mutation detection in the FBN1 gene.
unread.why: The study derives a clinically usable feature-combination rule that improves selection of probands for high-yield FBN1 molecular screening.

unread.title: Increased frequency of FBN1 truncating and splicing variants in Marfan syndrome patients with aortic events.
unread.why: The study provides patient data showing that truncating or splicing FBN1 variants identify Marfan patients with higher aortic-event risk and can inform management.

unread.title: Sensitivity of conformation sensitive gel electrophoresis in detecting mutations in Marfan syndrome and related conditions.
unread.why: The study validates CSGE as a sensitive FBN1 mutation-screening assay and demonstrates its utility for molecular diagnosis in Marfan syndrome and related fibrillinopathies.

unread.title: FBN1 mutation screening of patients with Marfan syndrome and related disorders: detection of 46 novel FBN1 mutations.
unread.why: Direct analysis of 99 patients achieved an 88% FBN1 detection rate in Marfan syndrome and linked variant classes to ocular and skeletal manifestations.

unread.title: Next-generation sequencing of 32 genes associated with hereditary aortopathies and related disorders of connective tissue in a cohort of 199 patients.
unread.why: The study validates a multigene hereditary-aortopathy sequencing strategy in a connective-tissue cohort and reports its diagnostic yield and variant reclassification performance.

unread.title: Mutation spectrum of the fibrillin-1 (FBN1) gene in Taiwanese patients with Marfan syndrome.
unread.why: A large Taiwanese cohort validates PCR/DHPLC screening and produces a substantial FBN1 mutation resource with clinically relevant detection and diagnostic performance.

unread.title: Cionni endocapsular ring implantation in Marfan's Syndrome.
unread.why: The case series reports improved visual acuity and optical outcomes after Cionni ring-supported lens implantation for Marfan-associated lens subluxation, although the publication is retracted.

unread.title: Variability in gene-based knowledge impacts variant classification: an analysis of FBN1 missense variants in ClinVar.
unread.why: Provides a validated disease-specific framework and reanalyzed ClinVar resource for improving diagnostic interpretation of FBN1 variants.

unread.title: Evaluating Japanese patients with the Marfan syndrome using high-throughput microarray-based mutational analysis of fibrillin-1 gene.
unread.why: Demonstrates an FBN1 microarray resequencing workflow with a 71% mutation detection rate among clinically defined Marfan syndrome probands.

unread.title: Application of next-generation sequencing to screen for pathogenic mutations in 123 unrelated Chinese patients with Marfan syndrome or a related disease.
unread.why: Reports a targeted sequencing approach that identifies pathogenic variants in 78.9% of a 123-patient Marfan or related-disease cohort and characterizes associated phenotypes.

unread.title: Systematic screening of FBN1 gene unclassified missense variants for splice abnormalities.
unread.why: Tests an RNA-based workflow that detects splicing abnormalities among apparently missense FBN1 variants and documents the limitations of computational prediction.

unread.title: Identification of fibrillin-1 gene mutations in Marfan syndrome by high-resolution melting analysis.
unread.why: Demonstrates a high-throughput FBN1 diagnostic method with 98.78% sensitivity in the tested Marfan cohort.

unread.title: Aortic dilation, genetic testing, and associated diagnoses.
unread.why: Provides cohort data supporting sequencing and microarray-based differential diagnosis of aortic dilation, with Marfan syndrome as the most frequently recognized disorder.

unread.title: Risk Factors and Inadequacy of Screening for Sleep-Disordered Breathing in Children with Marfan Syndrome.
unread.why: Directly evaluates noninvasive OSA screening in children with Marfan syndrome and provides data leading to a polysomnography-based monitoring recommendation.

unread.title: Overcoming challenges associated with identifying FBN1 deep intronic variants through whole-genome sequencing.
unread.why: The study demonstrates a complete diagnostic workflow for identifying and functionally characterizing deep intronic FBN1 variants missed by routine sequencing in Marfan families.

unread.title: Revised diagnostic criteria for the Marfan syndrome.
unread.why: The paper directly proposes and validates structured clinical and molecular criteria for diagnosing Marfan syndrome and distinguishing related heritable connective-tissue conditions.

unread.title: Update on Clinical Trials of Losartan With and Without β-Blockers to Block Aneurysm Growth in Patients With Marfan Syndrome: A Review.
unread.why: The review reports tested Marfan syndrome therapies and trial outcomes, while identifying the lack of adequately powered evidence for reducing dissection, surgery, and death.

unread.title: Inhibition of Marfan Syndrome Aortic Root Dilation by Losartan: Role of Angiotensin II Receptor Type 1-Independent Activation of Endothelial Function.
unread.why: The animal study provides direct mechanistic evidence that losartan can reduce Marfan aortic-root dilation through endothelial effects independent of ATR1 inhibition and blood-pressure lowering.

unread.title: Midterm outcome of valve-sparing aortic root replacement in inherited connective tissue disorders.
unread.why: This study reports midterm surgical outcomes in 60 patients with inherited connective tissue disorders, including 54 with Marfan syndrome, and identifies procedural factors associated with durability.

unread.title: Generation of human induced pluripotent stem cell line UGENTi001-A from a patient with Marfan syndrome carrying a heterozygous c.7754 T > C variant in FBN1 and the isogenic control UGENT001-A-1 using CRISPR/Cas9 editing.
unread.why: The report generates a patient-derived Marfan iPSC line and a genetically matched isogenic control, directly providing reusable in vitro disease-modeling resources.

unread.title: Losartan in combination with propranolol slows the aortic root dilatation in neonatal Marfan syndrome.
unread.why: A neonatal Marfan case reports reduced aortic-root dilatation and improved heart-failure control after losartan combined with propranolol, providing directly applicable drug evidence.

unread.title: The revised Ghent nosology for the Marfan syndrome.
unread.why: The revised Ghent nosology provides a validated clinical diagnostic framework for Marfan syndrome, including pediatric considerations, FBN1 testing, aortic root aneurysm, and ectopia lentis criteria.

unread.title: Effect of mutation type and location on clinical outcome in 1,013 probands with Marfan syndrome or related phenotypes and FBN1 mutations: an international study.
unread.why: This large Marfan cohort provides clinically validated mutation-based predictors of systemic severity, ectopia lentis, aortic disease, surgery, and survival.

unread.title: Loss-of-function mutations in TGFB2 cause a syndromic presentation of thoracic aortic aneurysm.
unread.why: The study supplies experimentally validated Marfan and compound aortic aneurysm models that dissect TGF-beta-dependent disease modification.

unread.title: Update of the UMD-FBN1 mutation database and creation of an FBN1 polymorphism database.
unread.why: These Marfan-specific databases directly support FBN1 variant interpretation, diagnostics, genotype-phenotype analysis, and research prioritization.

unread.title: Marfan syndrome: defective synthesis, secretion, and extracellular matrix formation of fibrillin by cultured dermal fibroblasts.
unread.why: Cultured Marfan fibroblasts and their quantitative fibrillin processing assay expose distinct biochemical defects and provide a disease-specific cellular model.

unread.title: Fifteen novel FBN1 mutations causing Marfan syndrome detected by heteroduplex analysis of genomic amplicons.
unread.why: The study demonstrates a sensitive heteroduplex-based method that detected 15 FBN1 mutations and detected disease in 78% of the initial probands.

unread.title: Vascular smooth muscle cell phenotypic changes in patients with Marfan syndrome.
unread.why: The study tests TGF-beta inhibition in Marfan patient-derived cells and identifies modifiable cellular and matrix abnormalities relevant to aortic disease.

unread.title: Beneficial Outcome of Losartan Therapy Depends on Type of FBN1 Mutation in Marfan Syndrome.
unread.why: A randomized Marfan trial shows that losartan reduces aortic-root dilation specifically in patients with FBN1 haploinsufficiency.

unread.title: Mutations in calcium-binding epidermal growth factor modules render fibrillin-1 susceptible to proteolysis. A potential disease-causing mechanism in Marfan syndrome.
unread.why: The paper experimentally models Marfan FBN1 variants and quantifies their structural instability and increased proteolytic susceptibility.

unread.title: Identification of sixty-two novel and twelve known FBN1 mutations in eighty-one unrelated probands with Marfan syndrome and other fibrillinopathies.
unread.why: This large diagnostic study validates sequencing and DHPLC for FBN1 detection and provides clinically relevant genotype-phenotype data.

unread.title: UMD-predictor, a new prediction tool for nucleotide substitution pathogenicity -- application to four genes: FBN1, FBN2, TGFBR1, and TGFBR2.
unread.why: UMD-Predictor is validated on a large FBN1-containing dataset and offers high-accuracy computational interpretation of potentially pathogenic variants.

unread.title: Identification of 23 TGFBR2 and 6 TGFBR1 gene mutations and genotype-phenotype investigations in 457 patients with Marfan syndrome type I and II, Loeys-Dietz syndrome and related disorders.
unread.why: Large-cohort molecular screening quantifies diagnostic yield across Marfan and related aortic-disorder phenotypes and identifies recurrent causal variants.

unread.title: Detection of thirty novel FBN1 mutations in patients with Marfan syndrome or a related fibrillinopathy.
unread.why: This study directly reports high-throughput FBN1 mutation screening in patients with Marfan syndrome or related fibrillinopathy, including 93% detection for Ghent-positive cases and genotype-phenotype associations.

unread.title: Proteomic analysis in aortic media of patients with Marfan syndrome reveals increased activity of calpain 2 in aortic aneurysms.
unread.why: Using patient aortic samples, this study identifies and validates calpain-related filamin A cleavage and calpain 2/calpastatin changes as measurable mechanisms and potential biomarkers of Marfan aortic aneurysm.

unread.title: Evaluation and application of denaturing HPLC for mutation detection in Marfan syndrome: Identification of 20 novel mutations and two novel polymorphisms in the FBN1 gene.
unread.why: This study evaluates DHPLC for FBN1 mutation detection in Marfan syndrome, reports 89–99% sensitivity, and identifies previously unknown variants, making it a directly reusable diagnostic assay.

unread.title: Consequences of cysteine mutations in calcium-binding epidermal growth factor modules of fibrillin-1.
unread.why: The study experimentally models three FBN1 mutations using recombinant polypeptides expressed in mammalian cells and assays their structural and proteolytic consequences.

unread.title: Two novel and one known mutation of the TGFBR2 gene in Marfan syndrome not associated with FBN1 gene defects.
unread.why: This study identifies pathogenic TGFBR2 variants in FBN1-negative patients diagnosed with or suspected of having Marfan syndrome and recommends targeted sequencing for this subgroup.

unread.title: Mutation screening of the fibrillin-1 (FBN1) gene in 76 unrelated patients with Marfan syndrome or Marfanoid features leads to the identification of 11 novel and three previously reported mutations.
unread.why: The study directly reports a full-exon SSCP screening strategy for FBN1 in patients with Marfan syndrome or marfanoid features and identifies multiple novel mutations.

unread.title: Mutation screening of all 65 exons of the fibrillin-1 gene in 60 patients with Marfan syndrome: report of 12 novel mutations.
unread.why: The study demonstrates a comprehensive FBN1 exon-screening approach and reports mutation-detection rates in Marfan families and sporadic cases.

unread.title: Detection of 53 FBN1 mutations (41 novel and 12 recurrent) and genotype-phenotype correlations in 113 unrelated probands referred with Marfan syndrome, or a related fibrillinopathy.
unread.why: The study analyzes 113 Marfan or Marfan-like probands, detects 53 FBN1 mutations, and reports genotype associations that can support molecular diagnosis and risk interpretation.

unread.title: Aortic biomechanical properties in pediatric patients with the Marfan syndrome, and the effects of atenolol.
unread.why: The paper directly evaluates atenolol’s effects on aortic biomechanical properties in pediatric Marfan syndrome, providing disease-specific therapeutic evidence.

unread.title: Recent Clinical Drug Trials Evidence in Marfan Syndrome and Clinical Implications.
unread.why: This review synthesizes randomized clinical-trial evidence for atenolol, losartan, and other beta-blocker or angiotensin-receptor-based strategies to limit aortic root dilation in Marfan syndrome.

unread.title: C-terminal propeptide is required for fibrillin-1 secretion and blocks premature assembly through linkage to domains cbEGF41-43.
unread.why: Provides a tested structure-informed engineering system for examining fibrillin-1 secretion and microfibril assembly relevant to FBN1-related Marfan syndrome.

unread.title: Combination of Panel-based Next-Generation Sequencing and Clinical Findings in Congenital Ectopia Lentis Diagnosed in Chinese Patients.
unread.why: The targeted sequencing strategy improved etiologic diagnosis of ectopia lentis and identified a small subset of patients with FBN1-associated Marfan syndrome.

unread.title: A deficiency of cysteine impairs fibrillin-1 deposition: implications for the pathogenesis of cystathionine beta-synthase deficiency.
unread.why: Cysteine depletion reduced fibrillin-1 deposition and restoration with normal cysteine reversed the defect, suggesting a transferrable nutritional therapeutic strategy for FBN1-related connective-tissue phenotypes.

unread.title: Cellular and molecular studies of Marfan syndrome mutations identify co-operative protein folding in the cbEGF12-13 region of fibrillin-1.
unread.why: The study supplies experimental structural and cellular assays for directly characterizing how Marfan-associated FBN1 variants disrupt protein folding and secretion.

unread.title: Preimplantation genetic diagnosis for Marfan syndrome.
unread.why: It demonstrates a mutation-specific, multiplex-PCR-based PGD workflow tested across clinical cycles in couples carrying FBN1 variants.

unread.title: Application of dHPLC for mutation detection of the fibrillin-1 gene for the diagnosis of Marfan syndrome in a National Health Service Laboratory.
unread.why: The optimized dHPLC workflow provides a validated high-throughput method for detecting FBN1 mutations in Marfan and Marfan-like phenotypes.

unread.title: Decreased frequency of FBN1 missense variants in Ghent criteria-positive Marfan syndrome and characterization of novel FBN1 variants.
unread.why: The cohort supplies FBN1 testing and genotype-phenotype data that improve interpretation of suspected Marfan syndrome and the revised Ghent criteria.

unread.title: Marfan syndrome-causing mutations in fibrillin-1 result in gross morphological alterations and highlight the structural importance of the second hybrid domain.
unread.why: The engineered fragments and biophysical assays directly characterize structural consequences of Marfan-associated FBN1 mutations.

unread.title: Comparison of heteroduplex analysis, direct sequencing, and enzyme mismatch cleavage for detecting mutations in a large gene, FBN1.
unread.why: A direct comparison in Marfan patients identifies enzyme-mediated mismatch cleavage as an efficient FBN1 mutation-detection method and clarifies the cost-efficiency tradeoffs of available assays.

unread.title: Quantitative sequence analysis of FBN1 premature termination codons provides evidence for incomplete NMD in leukocytes.
unread.why: The validated quantitative sequencing assay measures FBN1 nonsense-allele fractions and incomplete nonsense-mediated mRNA decay in blood and patient fibroblasts.

unread.title: Mutation analysis of the FBN1 gene in a cohort of patients with Marfan Syndrome: A 10-year single center experience.
unread.why: The study directly validates a two-step FBN1 NGS and MLPA diagnostic workflow in suspected Marfan syndrome and expands the disease-associated variant spectrum.

unread.title: Genetic testing of the FBN1 gene in Chinese patients with Marfan/Marfan-like syndrome.
unread.why: The study directly tests FBN1 in 39 Marfan or Marfan-like probands and identifies 29 pathogenic or likely pathogenic mutations.

unread.title: A population-based survey of FBN1 variants in Iceland reveals underdiagnosis of Marfan syndrome.
unread.why: The study combines clinical sequencing with population-scale genotype data to identify FBN1 variants and quantify underdiagnosis of Marfan syndrome.

unread.title: Clinical and genetic findings in Chinese families with congenital ectopia lentis.
unread.why: The study identifies causative FBN1 variants in Marfan or isolated ectopia lentis families and characterizes genotype-phenotype associations.

unread.title: Cardiovascular manifestations of Marfan's syndrome: improved evaluation by transoesophageal echocardiography.
unread.why: Transoesophageal echocardiography rapidly detected or excluded aortic dissection and improved cardiovascular evaluation in Marfan patients.

unread.title: Genotype-phenotype analysis of F-helix mutations at the kinase domain of TGFBR2, including a type 2 Marfan syndrome familial study.
unread.why: The study directly links TGFBR2 variants to type 2 Marfan syndrome and reports that losartan slowed aortic-lesion progression.

unread.title: Autosomal dominant Marfan syndrome caused by a previously reported recessive FBN1 variant.
unread.why: Clinical and segregation data from 14 carriers establish an FBN1 variant as a cause of dominant Marfan syndrome with variable aortic severity.

unread.title: High-Throughput Genomics Identify Novel <i>FBN1/2</i> Variants in Severe Neonatal Marfan Syndrome and Congenital Heart Defects.
unread.why: The study applies high-throughput genomic testing to identify an FBN1 variant in a newborn with severe neonatal Marfan features and complex congenital heart defects.

unread.title: Successful management of a patient with Marfan syndrome complicated with acute aortic dissection using landiolol during Cesarean section.
unread.why: The report shows that short-acting landiolol controlled heart rate while maintaining blood pressure, uterine activity, and hemodynamic stability during Cesarean delivery in a pregnant patient with Marfan-associated acute aortic dissection.
